name: phasor
summary: Q32 phase accumulator. `inc` (note-derived) is the pitch; `pitch` (control, Q15) scales it — full-scale = ±1 octave — and `detune` (cents −50..50) adds an exact per-operator offset via `fm1_detune_pitch`. `fm` (audio, Q15) is scaled `<<16` (full-scale = ±π, the FM index); `mod` (control) is a small additive offset.
